# 10 July Fix-It: the short version

Getting in: Room B is on the first floor. Take the lift by the children's library.

When: Saturday 10 July, 10:30am to 1pm.

Where: Millbrook Library, Room B.

Book a place on the library's events page. 32 places.

Bring your broken thing and its charger.

Please leave at home: microwaves, gas appliances, swollen batteries, e-bike and e-scooter batteries, and power tool batteries over 36 V.

Ask the library events desk: 555-0100.
